mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_activity_quota (u_id, activity_id, total_count, left_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uId}, #{activityId}, #{totalCount}, #{totalCount}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE u_id = u_id
mapper.update: UPDATE user_activity_quota SET left_count = left_count - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND activity_id = #{activityId} AND left_count > 0
